'''CT-66-3339''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] and part of the [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] trainee [[unit]] named [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]].

==Biography==
When [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] arrived to supervise the graduation tests of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] cadets, Bravo Squad was the first team to take the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]]. During this challenge, the cadets worked as a team and got close to the citadel. This cadet told [[CT-66-3238/Legends|their teammate]] to go for the tower while the others covered him. The cadet succeeded and Bravo Squad finished the course in record time.

==Behind the scenes==
This Bravo Squad cadet's identification number was first depicted in the episode "[[Clone Cadets]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. It says 66-3339, and the prefix CT- was predetermined. This way of determining identification numbers was proved with the troopers in Domino Squad.
